name: GPUI Kit
summary: Rust component library and desktop application framework for building cross-platform apps with GPUI.
description: GPUI Kit is a Rust desktop application framework built on GPUI, the UI framework from Zed, shipping 75+ documented components across forms, navigation, overlays, data display, editing, feedback and layout. It adds dock layouts, virtualized data tables and lists, a Tree-sitter code editor, charts, Markdown/HTML rendering and Lucide icons in three layers — styled gpui-component, unstyled gpui-base and gpui-shell JavaScript extensions — plus skills for AI coding agents.
contains: families: forms, navigation, overlays, data display, editing, feedback, layout
dock layout with resizable panels, draggable tabs and nested splits
virtual-scrolling data tables and lists; Tree-sitter code editor with LSP
charts, Markdown and HTML rendering, bundled Lucide icons
AccessKit accessibility, WebAssembly support, 120 FPS rendering
